_comment: Gold labels for sample_resume_005.txt (messy two-column text simulation). The .txt interleaves two columns the way naive PDF text extraction does, mixes bullet glyphs (>, *, -, •), and splits 'Network Administration' and 'Pine Valley Community College' across lines. Annotation decisions: Northwind Data is ONE organization (canonical name without the ', LLC' suffix) even though it appears with and without the suffix across two roles; the skill is 'VMware vSphere' as printed in SKILLS, not bare 'VMware'.
